question: When will NACH 3.0 be launched?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**July 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Faster salary credit, SIP debit, EMI payment and more under new NACH 3.0 system by NPCI from July 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**NACH 3.0** will be launched in **July 2025** by **NPCI** (National Payments Corporation of India).

 
 
• 
 
It will enable **faster salary credits**, **EMI payments**, and **mutual fund SIP processing**.

 
 
• 
 
Key improvements:

 
 
• 
 
**Enhanced security**

 
 
• 
 
**Improved user interface**

 
 
• 
 
**Optimized file handling**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Benefits for users:

 
 
• 
 
**Quicker transactions**

 
 
• 
 
**Real-time monitoring**

 
 
• 
 
**Better data protection**

 
 
• 
 
**Fewer errors**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**NACH** (National Automated Clearing House) is the **core system for recurring inter-bank transactions** in India.
